languagePolicy: Any language may supply equivalent independently replayable evidence. Proof tools are development dependencies.

populations.standard: Every normative paragraph, numbered rule, operation registry entry and schema assertion in version.json.
populations.reference: Local author, kernel, caller, executor, peer, operator and domain adapter. Independent Python/Go reference paths on the POSIX machine, persistent fixture stores, stdio and isolated network transport.
populations.deployment: Owner-selected real Kubernetes stand, deployed from this checkout; actual API server, pods, persistent storage, service identity and observations, local and explicitly addressed remote cluster. Provider accounts and training inputs remain synthetic. No commercial upstream or hard real-time target is claimed.

assurance.model: Kernel-checked statement of a selected invariant, realizability, refinement, or conditional progress. Freeze formal type and semantic definitions and audit all transitive axioms.
assurance.source: Program-specific derivation from actual source, with explicit, checked translator boundary. Runtime probes exercise surrounding code but cannot substitute for a source theorem.
assurance.build: Identify exact executable or interpreter, source, options, ABI and libraries. An artifact observation establishes the behavior seen on that build. A mathematical binary claim additionally requires a checked compilation, translation witness or machine-code proof.
assurance.measurement: Identify target, workload, observation clock, conditions, limit and oracle. Check positive and refusal outcomes. Use replayable receipts with trusted provenance, issued time and maximum age.
assurance.external: Operator-controlled, authenticated stand evidence. Absence of a real target receipt leaves the corresponding capability open.

acceptance.accounting: Every normative unit and atomic promise has a stable source locator, scoped role and acceptance criterion. Report coverage as a count per source/profile.
acceptance.execution: Every applicable evidence obligation has independently accepted evidence at the preregistered level under the original premises. Report separate numerators and denominators; open, stale, failed, skipped and weaker evidence prevent completion.
acceptance.mutation: Removal, weakening, vacuity, missing refusal, narrower inputs, changed executable, changed premise, borrowed certificate and stale operational record must be identified. A compatible addition, equivalent implementation and stronger proof must pass.

localCapacity.role: isolated soft-deadline read service and independent cells
localCapacity.target: actual built Go status caller and authenticated Python loopback receiver; separate processes
localCapacity.payload: resource demo; five second per-request budget

native.role: local reviewed ABI and handle simulator
native.target: running POSIX architecture and sealed soft-deadline status fixture
native.hardTiming: Admission must refuse an unqualified hard-deadline target; a p99 observation is insufficient.

stand.role: Kubernetes operator and hosted reference service
stand.target: repository-built Kubernetes stand on the local computer; same workload on an operator-selected remote Kubernetes
